_note: The products and their accounts the tracker follows. Add a product or an account here and push: the scraper picks it up on its next cycle, no code change. Set "active": false to pause an account or a whole product (its history stays). Removing an account from this file pauses it too. Every post is tracked as its own video, per platform and per product. Platforms: instagram, tiktok, facebook. 'handle' = the username without @; 'url' = the full profile address. 'avatar' (optional) = a square picture in public/avatars/, e.g. "/avatars/example_brand.jpg". The example below is inactive: replace it with your own accounts and set "active": true.
